title: A catalog zone provider can add a root zone as member and cause PowerDNS to provision it from the… (CVE-2026-123759)
description: CVE-2026-123759 is a vulnerability in PowerDNS where a catalog zone provider can add a root zone as a member, causing PowerDNS to provision it from the specified source. This behavior can lead to limited integrity and availability impacts. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 4.8.
